subject: Zelda's Letter
text: Princess Zelda gives Link Zelda's Letter with her autograph after meeting her for the first time in Hyrule Castle.

evidence.quote: After meeting with Princess Zelda for the...first time in Hyrule Castle, she will...give you this letter with her autograph.

subject: Zelda's Letter
text: Giving Zelda's Letter to the guard in Kakariko Village allows Link to pass through the gate and up Death Mountain.

evidence.quote: Give it to the guard in Kakariko...Village and he will allow you to pass...through the gate and up up Death Mt.

subject: Zora Mask
text: The Zora Mask can be borrowed from the shop at any time after selling all four normal masks.

evidence.quote: After you have sold all four of the...normal masks you can then borrow this...one from the shop any time you want.

subject: Zora Tunic
text: King Zora gives Link the Zora Tunic after being unfrozen in Zora's Domain following completion of the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: After completing the Ice Cavern, head...back to Zora's Domain and un-freeze...the King of the Zora, he gives you this.

subject: Zora Tunic
text: Wearing the Zora Tunic allows Link to breathe underwater forever.

evidence.quote: The Zora Tunic is a special piece of...clothing for Link to wear that allows...him to breathe underwater forever.

subject: Zora's Sapphire
text: The Zora princess entrusts Zora's Sapphire to Link after completing Inside of Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

evidence.quote: After you complete the Inside of Jabu-...Jabu's Belly, then the Zora princess...will entrust this artifact to Link.
